description: This experimental collection links RGB images of photovoltaic panels with electrical measurements under different shading and irradiance conditions. Researchers at three Colombian universities publish the data through Zenodo, including an Excel workbook and image archives under CC BY 4.0 for free reuse. The 2022 release supports image-based estimation of panel voltage and current, with the aim of reducing the number of physical sensors needed for reconfiguration or maximum-power-point tracking. Its site-specific experiments can calibrate or test monitoring models used in PV-system simulation. Coverage is limited to the observed panels and lighting situations; image predictions cannot be assumed to transfer unchanged to other installations. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
name: Dataset for detecting the electrical behavior of photovoltaic panels from RGB images
